goal: Measure the existing historical HELUT-graph versus scalar-Verilator row and a new closer paired end-to-end row using a deterministic persistent-worker Verilator baseline on the same emitted 8-bit ripple-adder source, without requiring a speedup.

fixture.lineage: One emitted Verilog source is compiled directly by Verilator and separately mapped through Yosys/ABC -lut 6 for HELUT.

scopes.historicalHELUT: Warmed host wall time around synchronized MPSGraph.run with feeds/results already allocated and packed.
scopes.historicalNative: Scalar native loop input assignment, Verilated model eval, output reads, and ordered FNV digest.
scopes.pairedHELUT: Per-trial assignment-mask generation, writes to every preallocated compiler input buffer including constant-low clk, synchronized MPSGraph.run, output-buffer traversal, decode, and ordered FNV digest.
scopes.pairedNative: Per-trial assignment-vector generation, persistent-worker start/completion synchronization, per-worker input writes including constant-low clk, one private Verilated model eval per lane, output collection, and serial ordered FNV digest.
scopes.nativePreparedDiagnostic: Persistent-worker synchronization, input writes, eval, output collection, and completion; excludes assignment-vector generation and ordered digest.

failurePolicy: Preserve any Swift failure, generated-C++ build failure, native worker failure, digest mismatch, unstable trial, missing sample, or absence/movement of either crossover. Do not lower B, trials, or worker count; do not select a favorable rerun. A code defect may be fixed only after banking this run and creating a new preregistration tied to the changed source hash.
claimBoundary: The paired scope is materially closer than the historical comparison but remains one release-Swift/MPSGraph implementation versus optimized generated C++ on one combinational circuit and unpinned host scheduler. It is not a pure GPU-kernel comparison, a best-possible native implementation, a sequential result, or a general performance claim.

plannedArtifacts.preservedGeneratedArtifact: Path printed by the test and copied beside the receipt after execution.
